## News Post Generator (free, no AI)

**Setup**
1. Telegram credential (bot token) on: Telegram Trigger, Get File, Send Reply, Send Document.
2. Run Gotenberg: docker run -d --restart unless-stopped -p 3000:3000 gotenberg/gotenberg:8
3. Optional: set ALLOWED_CHAT_ID in 'Parse Message'.
4. Activate the workflow.

**Usage** (send images as FILE for full quality)
- Single: Author | quote with *yellow words*
- Circle left: L: Author | quote  (then send circle image)
- Circle right: R: Author | quote  (then send circle image)
- Optional IG caption: ... || caption text

**Crop:** add [c:x,y,zoom] (circle) and/or [b:x,y,zoom] (background) to the caption. x,y = % point of the photo to center, zoom >= 1. Use crop-picker.html to get the numbers.
